time-tracker.title: MCP Time Tracker
time-tracker.tagline: Track billable time without leaving the chat.
time-tracker.does: Starts and stops timers, records manual entries, sets hourly rates per project, and turns the log into reports grouped by project, day, task or tag, CSV exports and invoice-ready line items. Money is computed from seconds and integer cents in one rounding step so totals always add up.
time-tracker.for: Freelancers, consultants and developers who already work inside Claude Code, Cursor or Claude Desktop and bill by the hour.
time-tracker.example: "Start a timer for Acme, task: API refactor" ... "Stop it and show me this week's hours per project with amounts."
time-tracker.free: Unlimited timers and entries; reports, lists and CSV cover the last 7 days; 2 projects with rates. Currency per entry (EUR, USD, GBP, PLN).
time-tracker.pro: Full history, invoice_summary, group by tag, unlimited rated projects.

price-tracker.title: MCP Price Tracker
price-tracker.tagline: Check and watch product prices on ordinary shop pages.
price-tracker.does: Fetches a product page and extracts the price from JSON-LD, microdata, Open Graph tags, common price markup or a currency-aware text fallback, normalising 1.299,00 EUR and 1,299.00 USD alike. Stores watches with a price history, refreshes them, computes min, max and change, and flags target hits and drops of 5% or more. Manual entry covers pages that block bots.
price-tracker.for: Anyone who asks their assistant what something costs now, whether it dropped, or to keep an eye on it.
price-tracker.example: "What does this laptop cost right now?" ... "Watch it and tell me when it drops under 900."
price-tracker.free: Unlimited price checks with extraction confidence; 3 watches with 30 observations each; alerts_pending free; redirects off product pages are refused.
price-tracker.pro: Unlimited watches, full history, refresh all.

spreadsheet.title: MCP Spreadsheet
spreadsheet.tagline: Read, query, edit and convert xlsx and csv files safely.
spreadsheet.does: Opens xlsx, xlsm, xlsb, ods, csv and tsv files, guesses the header row on messy exports, sniffs delimiters, and answers questions with a safe expression language (no eval): filters, sorts, per-column stats, find, computed columns such as [Qty] * [Unit Price], and conversion between formats. It never overwrites the source unless told to.
spreadsheet.for: Anyone who says: open this file, tell me what is in it, filter it, add a column, save it.
spreadsheet.example: "Open orders.xlsx and show open orders over 5 units sorted by amount" ... "Add a Total column and save as CSV."
spreadsheet.free: Read, query (filters, group by, sum/avg/min/max), stats and find on files up to 5,000 rows; writes up to 500 rows, never a partial file above that.
spreadsheet.storage: Works on the user's own files; nothing else stored.

invoice.title: MCP Invoice
invoice.tagline: Numbered invoices with tax lines, rendered to a professional PDF.
invoice.does: Stores the issuer profile and clients, allocates invoice numbers that never repeat (INV-YYYY-NNNN), computes per-line rounding, multiple VAT rates and discounts in integer minor units, renders an A4 PDF with pdfkit (multi-page tables, totals, payment details), tracks paid status and reports overdue invoices. Pairs with the time tracker: hours become an invoice in the same chat.
invoice.for: Freelancers and small businesses that want to say: make an invoice for Acme, 12 hours at 90 EUR, due in 14 days.
invoice.example: "Invoice Acme for 12 h at 90 EUR with 23% VAT, due in 14 days, and give me the PDF."
invoice.free: 3 invoices per calendar month; overdue report free; PDF carries a small footer line.
invoice.pro: Unlimited invoices, no branding, logo, custom prefix.

expense-tracker.title: MCP Expense Tracker
expense-tracker.tagline: Receipts, mileage and expenses that turn into invoice lines.
expense-tracker.does: Logs expenses with per-expense currency, VAT split and receipt attachment (path + sha256), auto-categorises merchants by rules, records mileage with country rate tables, summarises by category, project, month or merchant per currency, exports CSV or xlsx, and emits invoice-ready line items (net + tax rate, so nothing is taxed twice) for rebilling a project with optional markup.
expense-tracker.for: Freelancers and small businesses who already track time and invoice from chat and want the receipts side closed in the same place.
expense-tracker.example: "I paid 61.50 EUR at Media Markt for a USB hub, Acme project, billable" ... "Give me the invoice lines to rebill Acme this month with 10% markup."
expense-tracker.free: Unlimited logging; list and summary cover the last 30 days; 3 projects; 5 rules; CSV export up to 200 rows, never partial.
expense-tracker.pro: Full history, unlimited projects and rules, xlsx export, unlimited rebill items with markup.

office-suite.title: MCP Office Suite (bundle server)
office-suite.tagline: One install that exposes every tool of the five servers.
office-suite.does: A stdio proxy that starts the time tracker, price tracker, spreadsheet, invoice and expense tracker as child processes and exposes all their tools, resources and prompts under one server with a single license_status and license_activate. Measured reason: the most-used server in the category is an aggregator; one install beats five.
office-suite.for: Anyone who wants the whole freelancer workflow in one config line.
office-suite.example: "Start a timer for Acme" ... "Invoice Acme for this week's hours plus the USB hub receipt."
office-suite.pro: The $39 bundle key unlocks every child.

currency.title: MCP Currency Converter
currency.tagline: ECB reference rates: convert, history, and fx_rates for rebilling.
currency.does: Fetches and caches the European Central Bank daily and historical reference rates (keyless, free), converts any amount between currencies via EUR cross rates with the rate date stated, returns history tables with min, max and average, and emits the exact fx_rates object the expense tracker needs to rebill a project in one currency, so a model can chain the two without the user supplying rates.
currency.for: Freelancers billing across currencies and anyone who wants an honest, dated exchange rate without an API key.
currency.example: "What is 4,500 EUR in USD today?" ... "Rebill Nova in USD using today's rates."
currency.free: Latest rates, convert, convert_many, fx_rates_for, history up to 90 days.
currency.pro: Full history back to 1999, any-date rates, unlimited history windows.

docx.title: MCP Docx
docx.tagline: Real Word documents from chat: proposals, contracts, quotes.
docx.does: Creates .docx files from structured sections or markdown (headings, lists, tables, bold and italic), reads text back from existing Word files, fills {{placeholders}} in templates while keeping formatting, and generates structured proposals and freelance service agreements from the business profile, with an HTML export for printing.
docx.for: Freelancers who send proposals and contracts and want them as editable Word files, not PDFs.
docx.example: "Write a proposal for Acme: redesign, 3 phases, 4,500 EUR, valid two weeks." ... "Fill my NDA template with these names."
docx.free: Create, convert and read documents without limit; 3 proposals or contracts per calendar month; templates up to 10 placeholders.
docx.pro: Unlimited proposals and contracts, letterhead with logo and colours, unlimited template fills.

timezone.title: MCP Timezone Planner
timezone.tagline: Find meeting slots inside everyone's working hours.
timezone.does: Converts times between IANA zones with correct DST via Intl, resolves cities and countries to zones, finds ranked meeting slots where every participant is inside working hours with a fairness score, computes daily overlap windows, DST change dates and business days, stores contacts with their zones, and writes valid .ics calendar files.
timezone.for: Freelancers and small teams with clients in other time zones.
timezone.example: "When can I meet Sara in Sydney and Tom in Austin next week, one hour?" ... "Send me an ics for Tuesday 15:00 Warsaw."
timezone.free: Conversions, overlap, DST, business days, slots for up to 3 participants over 5 days, 5 contacts, 3 ics per month.
timezone.pro: Unlimited participants, days, contacts and ics files, recurring slot search.
